title: How do I re-download RPG Maker MV on a new computer

posts.author: Berylstone
posts.body: I recently got a new computer and am having some issues finding where to re-download RPG Maker MV on it.  I still have my old product key but can't figure out where to initialize the download.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
either download the trial and use the key to activate it, or use the key to activate it on steam.
(it's only one licence, but you can activate both if you're the only one who uses it)

posts.author: Piyan Glupak
posts.body:
The download for the free trial is the one that you need. Download it, and open it. It will either give you a free one month trial, or say that your trial period has ended. In either case, it should offer you the option of entering the product key.
You probably already know the link, but in case you don't:
https://www.rpgmakerweb.com/products/rpg-maker-mv
By the way, this forum is due to be shut down within 2 or 3 days. It might be a good idea to try and have a go downloading and inputting the product code very soon, in case you need more help or advice.
Good luck.
Edit: Andar got his reply out while I was typing!

the product key should be five blocks of five letters or numbers each.
have you tried it both on the trial and on steam? because while the key is identical, they use different servers for checking, and it wouldn't surprise me if the trial server is temporarily down - steam on the other hand should have more than enough server capacity.

posts.author: Piyan Glupak
posts.body:
Another thought - My MV product key has a mixture of numbers and upper-case letters. Zero can be confused with upper-case 'o' (0 or O), and one with upper-case 'i' (1 or I) in some fonts.
Edit
: My MV product key seems to have 3 blocks of five  upper-case letters or numbers. The 3 blocks are separated by hyphens: '-'. Don't know whether you used a word-processor to make a note of the product code, but sometimes word processors change hyphens to a different character, a longer dash. I became aware of this issue when making notes about JavaScript calls and plugin parameters, and copying and pasting my word-processed notes into plugin parameters and script boxes..
